table.name: TLGNC_TRAFFIC_JAM
table.description: Stores timeperiods when a truck is in a traffic jam. the info is usually sent by PDA.

column.name: TRUCK_ID
column.description: FK tlgnc_truck. Truck ID, to which this record is related.

column.name: START_DAT
column.description: The date/time when the traffic jam event was sent by the PDA = start of traffic jam for Logon.

column.name: END_DAT
column.description: The end date/time of the traffic jam. In case it's open end (traffic jam still ongoing), a hardcoded date of 31.12.9999=infinite is set.
